 #version 120

uniform sampler2D DiffuseSampler;

varying vec2 texCoord;
varying vec2 oneTexel;

void main(){
    vec4 center = texture2D(DiffuseSampler, texCoord);
    vec4 left = texture2D(DiffuseSampler, texCoord - vec2(oneTexel.x, 0.0));
    vec4 right = texture2D(DiffuseSampler, texCoord + vec2(oneTexel.x, 0.0));
    vec4 up = texture2D(DiffuseSampler, texCoord - vec2(0.0, oneTexel.y));
    vec4 down = texture2D(DiffuseSampler, texCoord + vec2(0.0, oneTexel.y));
    float leftDiff  = abs(center.a - left.a);
    float rightDiff = abs(center.a - right.a);
    float upDiff    = abs(center.a - up.a);
    float downDiff  = abs(center.a - down.a);
    float total = clamp(leftDiff + rightDiff + upDiff + downDiff, 0.0, 1.0);
    vec3 outColor = center.rgb * center.a + left.rgb * left.a + right.rgb * right.a + up.rgb * up.a + down.rgb * down.a;
    gl_FragColor = vec4(outColor * 0.2, total);
}

########ShaderSource : 
 #version 120

uniform sampler2D DiffuseSampler;

varying vec2 texCoord;
varying vec2 oneTexel;

uniform vec2 InSize;

uniform vec2 BlurDir;
uniform float Radius;

void main() {
    vec4 blurred = vec4(0.0);
    float totalStrength = 0.0;
    float totalAlpha = 0.0;
    float totalSamples = 0.0;
    for(float r = -Radius; r <= Radius; r += 1.0) {
        vec4 sample = texture2D(DiffuseSampler, texCoord + oneTexel * r * BlurDir);

		// Accumulate average alpha
        totalAlpha = totalAlpha + sample.a;
        totalSamples = totalSamples + 1.0;

		// Accumulate smoothed blur
        float strength = 1.0 - abs(r / Radius);
        totalStrength = totalStrength + strength;
        blurred = blurred + sample;
    }
    gl_FragColor = vec4(blurred.rgb / (Radius * 2.0 + 1.0), totalAlpha);
}

in vec2 oneTexel;

uniform vec2 InSize;

uniform vec2 BlurDir;
uniform float Radius;

void main() {
    vec4 blurred = vec4(0.0000000);
    float totalStrength = 0.0000000;
    float totalAlpha = 0.0000000;
    float totalSamples = 0.0000000;
    for(float r = -Radius; r <= Radius; r += 1.0000000) {
        vec4 sample__ = texture(DiffuseSampler, texCoord + oneTexel * r * BlurDir);

		
        totalAlpha = totalAlpha + sample__.a;
        totalSamples = totalSamples + 1.0000000;

		
        float strength = 1.0000000 - abs(r / Radius);
        totalStrength = totalStrength + strength;
        blurred = blurred + sample__;
    }

////ec2(float(Size.x), float(Size.y));
}vec2 textureSize_(sampler2DShadow tex, float lod){
 ivec2 Size = textureSize(tex, int(lod));
 return vec2(float(Size.x), float(Size.y));
}vec4 textureGather_(sampler2D tex, vec2 P){
 ivec2 sz = textureSize(tex, 0);
 ivec2 tc = ivec2(floor(P * vec2(sz) - 0.5));
 ivec2 c0 = clamp(tc, ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 ivec2 c1 = clamp(tc+ivec2(1,0), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 ivec2 c2 = clamp(tc+ivec2(1,1), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 ivec2 c3 = clamp(tc+ivec2(0,1), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 return vec4(texelFetch(tex, c0, 0).r,
             texelFetch(tex, c1, 0).r,
             texelFetch(tex, c2, 0).r,
             texelFetch(tex, c3, 0).r);
}vec4 textureGather_(sampler2D tex, vec2 P, float comp){
 ivec2 sz = textureSize(tex, 0);
 ivec2 tc = ivec2(floor(P * vec2(sz) - 0.5));
 ivec2 c0 = clamp(tc, ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 ivec2 c1 = clamp(tc+ivec2(1,0), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 ivec2 c2 = clamp(tc+ivec2(1,1), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 ivec2 c3 = clamp(tc+ivec2(0,1), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 int k = int(comp);
 return vec4(texelFetch(tex, c0, 0)[int(k)],
             texelFetch(tex, c1, 0)[int(k)],
             texelFetch(tex, c2, 0)[int(k)],
             texelFetch(tex, c3, 0)[int(k)]);
}vec4 textureGather_Offset_(sampler2D tex, vec2 P, vec2 offset){
 ivec2 sz = textureSize(tex, 0);
 ivec2 tc = ivec2(floor(P * vec2(sz) - 0.5)) + ivec2(offset);
 ivec2 c0 = clamp(tc, ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));

 ivec2 tc = ivec2(floor(P * vec2(sz) - 0.5)) + ivec2(offset);
 ivec2 c0 = clamp(tc, ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 ivec2 c1 = clamp(tc+ivec2(1,0), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 ivec2 c2 = clamp(tc+ivec2(1,1), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 ivec2 c3 = clamp(tc+ivec2(0,1), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 return vec4(texelFetch(tex, c0, 0).r,
             texelFetch(tex, c1, 0).r,

varying vec4 Color;

uniform sampler2D _gl4es_TexSampler_0;

uniform float _gl4es_AlphaRef;
void main() {
vec4 fColor = Color;
vec4 texColor0 = texture2DProj(_gl4es_TexSampler_0, _gl4es_TexCoord_0);
vec4 texColor1 = texture2DProj(_gl4es_TexSampler_1, _gl4es_TexCoord_1);
fColor *= texColor0;
fColor *= texColor1;
if (floor(fColor.a*255.) <= _gl4es_AlphaRef) discard;

highp float FogF = clamp((gl_Fog.end - fog_c) * gl_Fog.scale, 0., 1.);
fColor.rgb = mix(gl_Fog.color.rgb, fColor.rgb, FogF);
gl_FragColor = fColor;
}

 return vec3(texture(shadow, coord), 0.0, 0.0);
}

varying vec4 Color;
varying highp vec3 FogSrc;
varying vec4 _gl4es_TexCoord_0;
uniform sampler2D _gl4es_TexSampler_0;
varying vec4 _gl4es_TexCoord_1;
uniform sampler2D _gl4es_TexSampler_1;
uniform float _gl4es_AlphaRef;
void main() {
vec4 fColor = Color;
vec4 texColor0 = texture2DProj(_gl4es_TexSampler_0, _gl4es_TexCoord_0);
vec4 texColor1 = texture2DProj(_gl4es_TexSampler_1, _gl4es_TexCoord_1);
fColor *= texColor0;
fColor *= texColor1;
if (floor(fColor.a*255.) <= _gl4es_AlphaRef) discard;
highp float fog_c = length(FogSrc);
highp float FogF = clamp(exp(-gl_Fog.density * fog_c), 0., 1.);
fColor.rgb = mix(gl_Fog.color.rgb, fColor.rgb, FogF);
gl_FragColor = fColor;
}

             texelFetch(tex, c1, 0)[int(k)],
             texelFetch(tex, c2, 0)[int(k)],
             texelFetch(tex, c3, 0)[int(k)]);

}vec2 textureSize_(sampler2DShadow tex, float lod){

 return vec2(float(Size.x), float(Size.y));
}vec4 textureGather_(sampler2D tex, vec2 P){
 ivec2 sz = textureSize(tex, 0);
 ivec2 tc = ivec2(floor(P * vec2(sz) - 0.5));
 ivec2 c0 = clamp(tc, ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 ivec2 c1 = clamp(tc+ivec2(1,0), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 ivec2 c2 = clamp(tc+ivec2(1,1), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 ivec2 c3 = clamp(tc+ivec2(0,1), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 return vec4(texelFetch(tex, c0, 0).r,
             texelFetch(tex, c1, 0).r,
             texelFetch(tex, c2, 0).r,
             texelFetch(tex, c3, 0).r);
}vec4 textureGather_(sampler2D tex, vec2 P, float comp){
 ivec2 sz = textureSize(tex, 0);

 ivec2 c3 = clamp(tc+ivec2(0,1), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));
 int k = int(comp);
 return vec4(texelFetch(tex, c0, 0)[int(k)],
             texelFetch(tex, c1, 0)[int(k)],
             texelFetch(tex, c2, 0)[int(k)],
             texelFetch(tex, c3, 0)[int(k)]);

 ivec2 c2 = clamp(tc+ivec2(1,1), ivec2(0), sz-ivec2(1));

fColor.rgb = mix(_gl4es_Fog.color.rgb, fColor.rgb, FogF);
FragColor = fColor;
}////or = fColor;
}////
